svg.title: Glacial Crossroads — refined 16-base layout
svg.desc: Professional interpretation of the supplied hand sketches. Main and secondary routes connect sixteen base areas. A separate mountain-ridges layer completes the indicated cirque rims and valley divides around all four sectors, leaving passes at routes. Terrain is a reference, not verified navigability.
svg.text: 16 starting areas · Routes, base areas and mountain ridges

g.inkscape:label: Legend and title
g.text: Mountain masses define the valleys and base basins; open saddles preserve the route network.
